name: La Terrazza
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to La Terrazza in Tirol!** Discover the perfect blend of Italian flair and Alpine charm at our cozy restaurant in the heart of **Tirol**. Indulge in authentic Italian cuisine with a local twist, served with a smile and a view that takes your breath away. Our terrace invites you to relax and enjoy the stunning surroundings of **Innsbruck**, whether you're savoring a glass of fine wine, a delicious **Kaiserschmarrn**, or a freshly baked **Apfelstrudel**. From hearty pasta dishes to crispy **Schnitzel**, every bite is a celebration of flavors. After dinner, warm up with a traditional **Tiroler Grüßl** or a creamy **Topfenstrudel**—the perfect end to a memorable evening. Come and experience **Tirol** like never before at **La Terrazza**—where every moment is a taste of paradise. --- **

Our Highlights

** - **

Sunset Dining

** Enjoy the golden hues of the **Alpen** as you dine under the stars. Our terrace offers an unforgettable view of **Innsbruck**’s skyline. - **

Italian-Österreichisch Fusion

** From **Risotto alla Milanese** with a **Tiroler Speck** twist to **Tiramisu** with a touch of **Vanille** from the **Zillertal**, our menu is a journey for your taste buds. - **

Local Specialties

** Try our **Käsespätzle** with a side of **Obazda**, or a **Wiener Schnitzel** with a fresh **Radieschen** salad—classic **Tirol** flavors reimagined. - **

Wine & Cocktails

** Sip on **Grüner Veltliner** from the **Leithagebirge** or a refreshing **Aperol Spritz** while taking in the mountain air. --- **
